children: Canada wireless network provider's Q3 revenue fell 3.2% yr/yr due to lower bookings, installation delays
Q3 adjusted EBITDA rose 3.9% as company reduced salaries and related expenses
Net loss narrowed in Q3 as company focused on cost discipline
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year in its press release
LOWER BOOKINGS AND INSTALLATION DELAYS - Co said revenue decline was primarily due to decreased bookings in 2025 and delays in installations for larger multi-site deployments
CUSTOMER BASE OPTIMIZATION - Revenue was also impacted by discontinuing service to unprofitable accounts, according to management
ARPA GROWTH - ARPA increased due to focus on mid-market and large, multi-location customers and expanding wallet share with existing customers
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the integrated telecommunications services peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Terago Inc is C$1.30, about 18.8% below its November 12 closing price of C$1.60
